note: Read by tools/export_map_paths.py. Estimated body lengths, in metres, for records whose own metadata.length_m is not set. Each entry is keyed by record id and holds "length_m" (a positive number) and "source" (where the number comes from, for example a dimension read from a paper's figure). The map uses a record's own length where it has one; an entry here for such a record is refused, so an estimate never replaces a length the record holds. The export marks a length taken from here as source "estimate". Nothing here comes from, or goes into, data/records. Left out on purpose: mosadegh2014_fPN (the paper gives a 10 cm rod, but does not say that is the length that bends; see also data/map_caveats.json) and mosadegh2014_sPN (the paper states no length for it).
